name: design-patterns
description: Control-flow rules and the Gang of Four design-pattern catalog, plus Pattern Check (Rule 0) enforcement for Claude Code.

plugins.name: design-patterns
plugins.description: 22 GoF patterns (code in TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go, C++, Rust), Tier-1 priority list, hook-enforced preamble on every source edit across all 7 languages, control-flow rules (no nested ifs, N+1 branches ladder, N+1 queries) with 6 detectors, Tier 0 non-GoF patterns (Null Object, Result, Repository, DI), GoF smell detection (Singleton/Observer/Command/Template Method + 7 more), cross-file duplicate finder, decision-log analyzer, /pattern-review command.
